scope: Offline development review preparation and self-reported observation collection. Retain all752 saved frames and296 source-target pairs per variant, including NO_FACE. Review32 focus pairs across MASK/BLEND, front/side and black/white. Do not infer objective identity, true age, mask ground truth, independent evaluation or G3 acceptance from a completed worksheet.
inputs: Hash-pin this protocol, both complete capture and identity reports, full37 target review and both implementation/test sources in a new study plan. Verify every saved PNG byte, capture/evaluator correspondence and common cohort/configuration. Saved producer/model execution is historical evidence, not re-executed or independently certified here.
worksheet: Exact immutable evidence binding and32 ordered records. Five ratings and accompanying notes per variant; all pending initially. Reviewer kind human or ai, reviewer name and timezone-aware recorded_at must be explicitly self-reported for answered fields. This is not authenticated authorship. Missing or duplicated records, changed pins/configurations, extra acceptance flags or blank explanations are rejected.
delivery: A fresh ignored output/research directory containing index.html, eight offline self-contained configuration pages, worksheet.json and report.json. Script/connect/form actions disabled by CSP; original PNG bytes are embedded without resampling. No listener, persistence, model, mask edit, registry or production integration.
acceptance: Exit0 means preparation or worksheet integrity validation completed, including valid pending drafts. Exit2 means invalid input; do not publish a result. Completeness is reported separately from self-reported human/AI origin. All quality/service/production flags and human_review_completed remain false, even if every field says no_obvious_issue. Actual A/B review and acceptance require their separate recorded decision.
